supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s sort shapes into more specific categories.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Sort triangles and quadrilaterals into subcategories. Understand that shared attributes of shapes can define a larger category, such as triangle or quadrilateral.
teachingSteps: Look for attributes named in the task: sides, angles, parallel sides.
Test each attribute even when a figure is rotated.
Justify or revise the classification with a labelled drawing.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Shape type depends on defining properties, not orientation or apparent size.
